title: Decorative · cycle strip (this replaces …)
description: Small horizontal flow with a label and a series of mono-typed items joined by arrows. Two tones via data-tone: 'warn' (secondary-gradient eyebrow + accent struck-through items, default — used for 'the cycle this replaces' patterns) and 'neutral' (gray eyebrow + plain items — used for positive 'this flows into' patterns). Up to 5 slot items; empty slots auto-hide.

source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-24 — cycle-strip pattern adopted as standalone decorative block (typically paired with StagesList)

notes: Drop inside a Section right above or below a StagesList. The dashed border + struck-through warn tone signals 'something you'd want to avoid' without introducing a separate red accent family.
data-tone='neutral' switches the eyebrow to gray and removes the strike-through, suitable for positive forward flows like 'Request → Schedule → Dispatch → Mobile → Bill'.
Below 720px, arrows are hidden and items stack vertically so the flow does not wrap with dangling separators.
Slots are 1–5. If a CMS admin leaves later items empty, set [hidden] on the empty .cycle-strip-item AND the .cycle-strip-arrow that precedes it (pairwise hide so arrows don't dangle).
